title: Eric Walker on TRW board

tellings.quote: interesting fact about TRW Jacques Valet has talked about Dr. Eric A. Walker we talked about earlier being a on the board of directors or a chairman of TRW as well.

plain: The claim is that Dr. Eric A. Walker, a man named in UFO stories, sat on the board of directors of TRW, a large American defense and aerospace company, or even chaired it. A guest who goes by UAPGerb, an online researcher, says the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée has talked about this. Linking Walker to TRW would tie him to a major defense contractor.
